# Privacy Notice - Udhaar Setu

This notice is available in English and in Hindi and the other languages listed in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution. Choose your language at the top of this page.

Udhaar Setu ('we') respects your privacy. This notice explains how we handle your personal data when you use Udhaar Setu.

## What personal data we collect
1. Full name
2. PAN
3. Aadhaar-based e-KYC details
4. Mobile number
5. Bank account and IFSC
6. Bank statements for the last 6 months
7. Device location at the time of applying

## Why we use it
We use this data only to:
1. Verify identity under KYC rules
2. Assess eligibility and creditworthiness for a loan
3. Disburse the loan to the bank account and collect EMIs
4. Detect fraud using the location at the time of applying

## Withdrawing your consent
To withdraw consent, use the 'Withdraw consent' button in your account settings or at udhaarsetu.com/privacy. It is as easy as giving consent was.

## Your rights
You have the right to access a summary of your personal data and our processing of it, and to have it corrected, completed, updated or erased. Send your request through udhaarsetu.com/privacy-requests. You can also nominate another person to exercise these rights for you if you die or become unable to do so. Add a nominee under Settings > Nominee.

## Complaints
If you have a grievance about how we handle your data, raise it under Help > Raise a grievance. We will respond within 15 days. If you are not satisfied with our response, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India through its online portal.

## Contact us
Questions about this notice or your data? Contact our Grievance Officer, Arjun Rao, at grievance@udhaarsetu.com.

## Keeping your data safe
We protect your data with encryption and access controls, and we keep it only as long as needed for these purposes.
